name: NDISCompliant
description: AI-powered compliance automation for Australian NDIS (National Disability Insurance Scheme) registered providers — generates policies, procedures, risk registers, and training matrices mapped to NDIS Practice Standards; gap analysis + regulatory monitoring. Description lists AUD $149 / $349 / $699 monthly tiers; profile also shows a $297 one-time SIL audit-ready document kit. Operated by Axior Labs (Bendigo VIC). Founded Jan 2025, Australia. ~40 estimated users.

mentions.evidence: MRR $0 / 0 seat subscriptions, ~$5,623 L30, ~$45,411 all-time, ~75% L30 profit margin. Last sync Oct 4, 2026 ~07:20 Warsaw (05:20 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Package audit-ready document kits + monitoring for one national disability / care scheme. Sell to ops managers before registration deadlines; deadline calendars are free marketing.

whyItPrints: Pure regulated vertical docs — Kibu cousin for AU disability providers facing SIL / audit deadlines. $0 seat MRR with ~$5.6k L30 and ~$45k all-time suggests pack / one-time + sporadic subscription billing around compliance deadlines. Bureaucracy is the product.
whyThisMatters:
The site is a directory where Australian NDIS providers compare software before they buy. You can look at 251 products, up to four at a time. Groups include care notes, rostering, plan management, quality and incidents, and allied health.

Wani Meridian publishes it. That's the team behind ProviderQMS. The lists are alphabetical. They say you can't pay for a higher spot. "Not verified" means they haven't checked that feature. You can download a short brief to take into a demo.

The company profile also describes policy drafts, risk registers, and training matrices for the NDIS standards, plus a gap check. That's Axior Labs in Bendigo, started in January 2025. The policy packs live on the profile. The site itself is the comparison list.
